For visitors

Listed in the club’s ‘All Speeds’ category. Sign the club waiver at the ride. Cancelled if the forecast is below 38 F or the roads are wet at the start. The club moved Cargo District Thursday earlier this month, so check the event page for the October start time.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Leisurely; do one, two or three laps of Greenfield Lake.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Flaming Amy’s Burrito Ride group ride

Flaming Amy’s Burrito Ride is a social and road group ride in Wilmington, NC. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:30 pm from Able Insurance (next to Flaming Amy’s Burrito Barn).

An easy early-evening ride that starts near Flaming Amy’s Burrito Barn. The group rolls about two miles through neighborhoods to Greenfield Lake, where each lap is about 4.5 miles. Ride one, two or three laps, then roll back for a burrito.
